name: Average Precision
formula_or_rule: sum (R_k-R_{k-1})*Pr_k over distinct score thresholds; ties grouped
baseline_or_reference: pi = P/n of the same eval set

name: Brier skill score
notes: Reference uses eval prevalence; not an achievable predictor

name: ECE (10 equal-width bins)
formula_or_rule: sum n_k/n |ybar_k - pbar_k|; bins [0,.1)..[.8,.9),[.9,1.0]; skip empty
low_support_rule: n<500 or P<20 -> LOW_SUPPORT_ECE; bin n_k<10 flagged
notes: Descriptive; no recalibration; not reported for family-vs-benign

name: FAR = FPR (flow-level)
notes: Only definition of FAR in D3-1

name: False alerts per valid observed hour
notes: H_valid = nominal window minus gaps recorded in metadata; silence is not a gap

name: False alerts per valid observed day
notes: If no coverage metadata: report FA_day_unadjusted with flag

name: Precision at budget K
formula_or_rule: E[TP_K]/K; K=ceil(b*n), b in {0.001,0.005,0.01,0.05} or K in {100,1000}; boundary ties by expectation r*a/g

name: Recall at budget K
notes: Family recall uses top-K of full E_t
